name: 27349 · Snow Camp, NC
findings: ZIP 27349 (Snow Camp) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27349 (Snow Camp) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 9% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 27349 (Snow Camp) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
